stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Index Definition
stories.description: Define MongoDB schema for Brain locks including fields: resource_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at. Create TTL index on expires_at and enforce unique constraint on active locks per resource. Document contract for all services using locks.

stories.title: Lock Management API (Acquire/Renew/Release)
stories.description: Implement backend service methods for lock acquisition, renewal (heartbeat extension), and release. Enforce ownership validation and TTL extension rules. Ensure idempotency and safe concurrent access using atomic MongoDB operations.

stories.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner execution flow. Ensure locks are acquired before assignment execution, renewed during long runs, and released on completion or failure. Handle crash recovery by relying on TTL expiration.
